AlisLink.title: AlisLink
AlisLink.description: Dynamic verification link generated by the system administrator.

owner.description: Owner identifier or administrator username who created the link (e.g. AbuSayedX).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the link was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the link expires.

status.description: Current status of the link: active, used, expired, or revoked.

verificationId.description: Associated unique verification ID once consumed.

VerificationRecord.title: VerificationRecord
VerificationRecord.description: Non-sensitive device/session telemetry and cryptographic verification record.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when verification was completed.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when this verification token expires.

referrer.description: Referrer URL where available or direct indicator.

alisId.description: Identifier of the alis link that initiated this verification.

ConnectionTest.title: ConnectionTest
ConnectionTest.description: Probe document to validate backend connectivity.

/test/{docId}.description: Probe path to test Firestore backend reachability.
